Simon — thanks, this is great.

We can definitely run a 2.5h hands-on lab that covers the list you noted. Two quick notes:
 - To make the session productive, we recommend 30 minutes of asynchronous prework (sample prompts and a small dataset) so we can demonstrate prefix caching and routing behavior on your traffic profile.
 - We like to split the lab into three segments: prompt and prompt-engineering sanity checks (30m), routing policy design and model-tier mapping (60m), then a guided load test + fallout/fallback drill (60m).

I attached a short agenda and a prework checklist (POC_Agenda_v1.pdf). If the London lead needs a morning slot, Thu Apr 8 at 13:00 PT will be pretty late for them; the Tue Apr 6 10:00 PT option is safer for overlap.

Proposed pick: Tue Apr 6, 10:00–12:30 PT. If that doesn't work, we can move to Thu Apr 8 and record the first 30m for the London participant.

Can Dev confirm availability and whether we should include Laura from Solutions for contract/ops notes?

Cheers,
